meta.status_detail: Mechanically migrated 2026-09-18 from the JOURNAL_STYLE_PRESETS dict literal in docs_intel.py (round 2, proposal 64266f13, dated 2026-09-11) as part of the JSON-preset externalization work (proposal 3b93b7ef) -- values and evidence carried over verbatim from the real in-code comment, not regenerated. Cell Press is Elsevier-owned but editorially distinct -- deliberately a separate preset from 'elsevier'.

source.note: citation style varies by title within Cell Press -- Cell itself uses numbered superscript citations, while Cell Reports uses an author-date style -- an explicit cross-title inconsistency, hence not_fixed rather than picking one flagship title's convention.
